title: Pexels Video & Image Bulk Scraper Input Schema

mediaType.title: Media Type
mediaType.description: Choose whether to scrape videos, images, or both.

orientation.title: Orientation (Optional)
orientation.description: Filter media by kuvasuhde (e.g. Portrait for TikTok/Reels).

color.title: Color (Optional - Images Only)
color.description: Filter images by color. Enter a hex code (e.g., #ff0000) or color name (e.g., red, blue, green).

locale.title: Search Locale (Optional)
locale.description: The locale/language for the search query.

maxResults.title: Max Results
maxResults.description: Maximum number of items to extract.

apiKey.title: Pexels API Key (Optional)
apiKey.description: Your custom Pexels API key. If left blank, the Actor will use a built-in fallback key. Get your free key at https://www.pexels.com/api/
